decisions.reason: We would keep the Google Analytics 4 tracking plugin because the market has shifted to GA4, it fits our analytics and plugin capabilities, and in a growing industry its likely performance meets or exceeds our aspiration under current customer demand.

We would drop the Google Universal Analytics tracking plugin because Universal Analytics has become obsolete, so expected results fall below aspiration and the resources are better reassigned to established services and newer development.

We would keep the retail system interface plugin because it is close to our core integration and customization business, offers cross-selling potential for shop clients, and with no clear negative signal we can use available slack to continue it while learning from the market.

We would keep the shop relaunch SEO support service because it directly matches our search marketing and relaunch expertise, was given strong website prominence, and is likely to meet aspirations by supporting client sales outcomes in our main service business.
